Your Bachelorette
Curated for NaDean · Playa Panamá, Costa Rica · September 24, 2026

NaDean, I went looking for a private morning charter that checks everything on your list — just your group, snorkeling along pristine coastline, drinks and bites onboard, and boarding right from the beach at El Mangroove with no transfers. My favourite local operator sails three beautiful catamarans, all at the same price, so the only decision left is which boat feels like yours.

01 — Your Private Morning Charter
Thursday, September 24 · 8:00am – 12:00pm · Two Days Before Your Wedding

One operator, one price, three catamarans to choose from. Every boat picks your group up right on the beach at El Mangroove, sails the Gulf of Papagayo past secluded coves — often with dolphins along the way — and anchors at a pristine spot for snorkeling and a secluded-beach visit. With 10 confirmed and room for up to 17, the per-person price only gets friendlier as more of your girls say yes.
